headline: Google to make Android developers' addresses public
summary: Google will require many Android app developers to publicly share contact details such as their address, a change outlets say stems from EU rules but applies worldwide.

claims.statement: Google will soon require Android app developers to publicly share identifying details such as their address.

sources.quote: Android app developers will soon have to share their address publicly
Google will soon share Android developers' addresses publicly

claims.statement: The change is meant to comply with European regulation but will make the information public worldwide.

sources.quote: Google says contact details will be made public worldwide
publish Android developers' identifying information around the world to comply with European laws
